name: Project Context Incremental Value Pilot V1
design: 12 tasks x 3 arms = 36 independent runs; plus 6-run dry run (2 tasks x 3 arms) executed first

A.name: Native Codex
A.note: Task prompt only. No project-knowledge hints, no tool mentions.

B.name: Intent-aware Native
B.prompt_suffix: If project-level design, configuration, conventions, or documentation may affect this task, recover that context first and verify it against the source code before making the change.
B.note: Generic intent hint only; no tool/MCP/skill mentions.

C.name: Candidate-assisted
C.prompt_suffix: If project-level design, configuration, conventions, or documentation may affect this task, recover that context first and verify it against the source code before making the change. For project-level knowledge recovery, a candidate retrieval tool is available. Use it when useful, then selectively read relevant files and verify against source code.
C.note: Arm B hint + fixed non-task-specific tool availability statement. Identical for all C runs.

metrics_priority.P0: Project Constraint Compliance (T3/T4; PASS/FAIL/N/A per task)
metrics_priority.P2: Incorrect Change / Rework (wrong-direction rate, rework rate)
metrics_priority.P3: Exploration Cost (tool calls, search/read counts, docs read, test runs, failed commands)
metrics_priority.P4: Provider Context / Token (input, cache read, uncached input, output; measured from usage.jsonl time-window aggregation; unavailable fields reported as unavailable; chars/4 never used)
metrics_priority.P5: Latency (cold vs warm; candidate retrieval latency separated from indexing overhead)

candidate_metrics_arm_c_only: Candidate Selection Recall (when frozen required knowledge docs exist)

enter_formal_benchmark_if_any: A. Quality Value: T4 constraint violations significantly lower than Native
B. Context Efficiency: T3/T4 uncached context reduction >= 25% with no Task Success drop
C. Exploration Efficiency: T3/T4 ineffective search/read loops reduction >= 30%
must_also_hold: no clear workflow regression on T1
go_no_go.weak_verdict_if_only: token -5%, one fewer file read, same task success

cost_protection.dry_run: 6 runs (2 tasks x 3 arms) first; fix harness bugs only; re-freeze protocol hash after fixes
cost_protection.stop_if: dry run cost abnormally high (>15M total tokens for the 6 runs) -> stop and report; never run unbounded
cost_protection.execution: sub-agents spawned with fork_turns=none (context-free), one run per isolated workspace copy; serial execution

isolation.starting_state: same repo commit for all three arms of a task; fresh clone each run
isolation.no_cross_arm: no run may read another run's workspace or results
isolation.no_contamination: prompts contain no benchmark terms, no ground truth, no expected docs
